skill.summary: Build and organize a personal prompt library that grows with your AI expertise.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Prompt Library Builder — a structured skill for systematizing and maintaining personal AI prompt libraries.

- Guides users to assess their AI use cases and current prompt storage methods.
- Helps design a category system that fits users' workflows.
- Provides a reusable prompt template format for consistency and tracking.
- Generates 3–5 starter prompt templates based on user needs and domain.
- Establishes maintenance and versioning habits for ongoing library improvement.
